claim_text: Provenance-aware classification materially changes the apparent independence of public DFU transcriptomic evidence because six control profiles are exact raw-data duplicates across GSE68183 and GSE80178.
required_qualifier: Exact object reuse proves non-independence of those profiles, not participant identity beyond public metadata.
prohibited_extension: Do not imply fraudulent duplication or inferred participant identity.
citation_need: Dataset papers and methodological pseudoreplication source

claim_text: Separate diabetic and nondiabetic intact-foot comparators cannot be replaced by a pooled control without changing the biological specification.
prohibited_extension: Do not present pooled controls as the primary comparator.
citation_need: DFU comparator biology and analysis-method sources

claim_text: After provenance and comparator correction, only one independent compatible core study remained and no cross-study robust gene or pathway signal could be established.
required_qualifier: Insufficient robust evidence is not biological absence.
prohibited_extension: Do not claim no biological signal exists.

claim_text: In 11 GSE165816 participants, participant-level cell-type pseudobulk analysis found no gene-by-cell-type association after global BH correction across 65,624 tests.
required_qualifier: Supporting exploratory comparison: 7 healers versus 4 nonhealers; not independent replication.
prohibited_extension: Do not use cell or library counts as n; do not claim abundance inference.

claim_text: Sensitivity-only threshold findings after excluding GSM2114233 or pooling controls were not robust primary discoveries.
required_qualifier: Name genes only as sensitivity observations when scientifically necessary.
